name: Ooki
rootCause: On February 15, 2020, Ooki (then bZx) was exploited on Ethereum mainnet. The attacker manipulated oracle price inputs via AMM swaps and multi-protocol flash loans, bypassing critical checks, which resulted in losses of approximately $650,000. Ooki's price oracle accepted spot prices directly from multiple on-chain DEXes (Kyber/Uniswap), with no aggregation or deviation bounds. A logic flaw let an attacker bypass slippage checks for overcollateralized loans, enabling profit from manipulated collateral values.
